method: Read-only Pillow RGB mean absolute difference of first 400x200 crop pixels against matching windows of the independently produced full JPEG; no raster edit or re-encode
finding: Actual pixels align with advertised crop plus the cloned root's additional relative left:-30px/top:-220px offset, rather than the advertised crop alone. JPEG differences are expected; the visual content and much closer double-offset match establish the defect.
